'''Transport 22''' was the designation for a [[StarSpeeder 3000]] craft owned by the [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] performed maintenance and repairs on this vessel while working at the travel agency months after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']]</ref>

A disaster nearly occurred when C-3PO, while distracted with a debate with R2-D2 regarding [[Droid rights/Legends|droid rights]], failed to check the fuel pressure and shut off the main line until R2-D2 warned him at the last minute. In addition, a few times the laser cannons nearly discharged, with R2-D2 often narrowly shutting them off.<ref name="ST" />

==Behind the scenes==
A full-size version of this speeder appeared in the queue of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction in various [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] theme parks.<ref name="ST" /> The speeder was repainted and modified to become a [[StarSpeeder 1000]] in the [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|second version]] of the attraction.<ref name="ST2">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>
